messages:
Kei (FinOps): Heads-up: saw 28 invoices that were posted twice to NetSuite after last night's DLQ replay. Some customers show duplicate AR lines. Putting notes here before we escalate.

Hannah (Payments Eng): Wow — do you have invoice IDs or the DLQ run id? Which replay command was used?

Kei (FinOps): DLQ run: replay-2026-04-10T03:00Z id=replay_20260410_03. Examples: inv_05Mz1D9Q, inv_05Mz2F0R. NetSuite export shows two rows per invoice with different ns_batch_ids. Looks like the replay didn't check posted_to_netsuite flag.

integrations-bot: Alert: netsuite.duplicate_posting detected count=28 at 2026-04-10T06:12:05Z. Ticket INC-2026-3550 created.

Tom (Billing Ops): I paused the NS import queue as a precaution. Please do not re-run the import until we have a cleanup plan. If any duplicates hit AR we need to mark the duplicates and reverse them.

Hannah (Payments Eng): Root cause hypothesis: replay tool used event-level dedupe but the apply path was bypassed for a short window while posted_to_netsuite flagging was delayed. The replay re-applied invoice.finalized -> exporter ran -> NS rows created again. Our idempotency uses invoice.checksum, but checksum is generated prior to exporter normalization so two different exporter runs can produce different ns_batch_ids and be treated as distinct.

Kei (FinOps): OK. Immediate ask: can we identify which NetSuite rows are duplicates and generate a remove list? We need to avoid manual crediting until we've reconciled.

Tom (Billing Ops): I'll diff the NetSuite import manifest against the prior run and create a removal CSV with ns_line_ids to void. Also tagging any invoices where payment_status!=open so AR can prioritize.

Hannah (Payments Eng): Fix plan: (1) add posted_to_netsuite guard into replay CLI so events for invoices with posted_to_netsuite=true are skipped unless --force; (2) change checksum location to post-export canonicalization so checksum includes exporter output; (3) add a short window lock around exporter to prevent concurrent writes for same invoice during replay. Opening payments/replay#501.

Kei (FinOps): For remediation: Tom - produce removal CSV and coordinate with AR to void duplicates; Hannah - patch repo and deploy; I'll run a revenue reconciliation after fixes.

Hannah (Payments Eng): Replay CLI patch ready. Example usage to skip posted invoices: 
```bash
./tools/replay_dlq --run-id replay_20260410_03 --skip-posted --dry-run
```
I'll deploy the patch to staging and run a dry-run of the DLQ to produce a list of invoices that would be modified.

Tom (Billing Ops): Generated remove list at gs://redwood-finance/ns/dups/2026-04-10-remove.csv. It contains 28 rows with ns_line_id and invoice_id. I'll hold execution until Hannah confirms replay will no longer re-create them.

integrations-bot: Incident INC-2026-3550 updated: status=mitigating, assignee=Hannah (Payments Eng).

Hannah (Payments Eng): Deployed replay guard to prod. Ran dry-run against replay_20260410_03, result: 0 invoices would be re-applied when --skip-posted is set. Live replay skipped 28 posted invoices. Posting logs: 
```
2026-04-10T06:35:12Z INFO replay_dlq run=replay_20260410_03 skipped=28 reason=posted_to_netsuite
```

Kei (FinOps): Great. Tom please proceed with removing duplicate NS rows and mark the ledger corrected. I'll then re-run the day reconciliation.

Tom (Billing Ops): Removal executed. AR team applied voids for the 28 duplicate lines; notes added to each invoice. NetSuite import queue remains paused for 15m to validate downstream effects.

Kei (FinOps): After reconciliation, revenue delta is zero-sum (voids matched duplicate lines). Closing idea: add a guard in netsuite-exporter to set an export_id and fail export if an invoice already has export_id in ledger. Also add alert netsuite.duplicate_lines.

Hannah (Payments Eng): Will add guard and unit tests. Postmortem owner: me. Immediate follow-ups: patch checksum placement, add replay --skip-posted default=true, add exporter-level export_id check, and add observability for duplicate_post_count.

Tom (Billing Ops): Notifying CS for any customer inquiries. No customer credits issued.

Kei (FinOps): Thanks team. Once postmortem is up, add the summary to finance retro.
